name: dsh-connector-ui
description: Fishball's UI in the main DeepSeek Harness: the one package that changes the host DSH's UI for Fishball (R-ARCH-04).
//: Lowercase name (S4-Q3 decided B). The host half is index.js with src/host/ (U-SHELL, U-DRAW: runtime service lookup, connector-missing and instance-missing, the notify and attention tool declaration, and its own owner-only Fetch routes for availability, status, admission and model sync). The browser half is src/client/client.js with its package-local chunks beside it, flat client.<part>.js files because DSH serves only client.<name>.js siblings of a package's client.js: client.shell.js, client.marks.js, client.attention.js, client.instance.js (U-DRAW removed client.records.js: no inline records, requirements 1.41 Q-G4); client.status.js there is a symlink to the instance-owned status line, which a release pack must dereference (DESIGN.md).
//peerDependencies: Both optional (design §9.1): the UI's parts follow the instance's and the connector's services and routes when present, and embed-UI imports no code of either. The range is the instance's own for the connector: from this release's 0.1.0-alpha.0 up to, not including, 2.

dsh.//client: The injects of the two V2 main-DSH clients it replaces, combined (design §9.1): the connector client's eight include the instance card's three.
